hero.title: Skin Boosters in Miami
hero.lede: Skin boosters at Real Aesthetic Medical Spa in Miami are injectable hyaluronic acid treatments — Profhilo-type — designed to hydrate the skin from within, improve elasticity and luminosity, and deliver a healthy, glassy glow without adding volume or shape.

blocks.title: What it does for you
list: Hydrates the dermis from within, improving skin softness and surface quality.
Supports collagen and elastin synthesis through targeted fibroblast stimulation.
Improves luminosity and the glassy, healthy look that a great moisturiser cannot reach.
Discreet improvement in firmness and elasticity in cheeks, lower face, neck, hands and décolletage.
Pre-event favourite when patients want skin to look its best for a wedding, photoshoot, or red-carpet moment.
Designed and supervised by Ronal Perdomo Lugo, APRN, FNP-C, with a consultation that confirms the indication.

faq.q: Are skin boosters the same as fillers?
faq.a: No. Both use hyaluronic acid, but they are designed for different goals. Fillers are structural — they project, lift, and contour. Skin boosters are quality treatments — they hydrate, smooth, and brighten the skin without adding shape or volume. We choose one or the other (or both, in different areas) based on the assessment.

faq.q: How many sessions do I need?

faq.a: No. Skin boosters do not add volume. The product is placed in micro-deposits to improve skin quality, hydration, and glow — not to project tissue. If you want more structural projection in cheeks, chin, or jawline, a traditional HA filler or biostimulator is the right tool, not a booster.
